dedupe_keys.name: floodx raw data metadata and preprocessing code

description: Eawag publishes the raw text observations, metadata and preprocessing code from the floodX urban flash-flood experiments at Wangen, Switzerland. The ZIP package groups readings by sensor, identifies instruments and locations, documents flooding experiments, and includes results extracted from photographs of sensor displays. Public access is free under CC0-1.0. The related Eawag project page describes a 25 by 25 metre testbed with surface flow, sewers and a building; the exact observation interval varies by instrument and is not established in the package summary. A major limitation is the provider warning that the c3_v_radar_hach and c3_v_radar_nivus velocity series contain systematic errors up to 50 percent and their absolute values must be disregarded. The remaining documented measurements can support urban hydraulic model calibration and processing comparisons. This package complements the separately deposited monitoring and calibration subsets with raw provenance and code. No files were obtained or processing executed.
